name: io.github.nithin554/code-crawler
title: Code Crawler
description: Static and dynamic call tracing MCP server backed by a SQLite property graph of your codebase

environmentVariables.name: CODECRAWLER_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite graph database (default ~/.code-crawler/index.db)

environmentVariables.name: CODECRAWLER_EXCLUDE_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directories to skip during crawl

environmentVariables.name: CODECRAWLER_DEFAULT_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Default result cap for list queries (default 50)

environmentVariables.name: CODECRAWLER_HELPFUL_ERRORS
environmentVariables.description: Fuzzy suggestions on unknown symbols (default true)
